[SWS_DM_00437] Security Level check for RoutineIdentifier
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04224, RS_Diag_04227
⌈
On reception of the UDS Service RoutineControl (0x31), the DM shall check if the
DiagnosticAccessPermission
referenced by the
DiagnosticRoutine
has per-
missions to be executed with the current security level and send a NRC 0x33 (Security
access denied) if the permissions are not given.
⌋
